user.title: Connect to TrueNAS SCALE
user.description: Requires TrueNAS SCALE 25.04 or newer. Create an API key in TrueNAS (top-right user menu → API Keys). The connection always uses HTTPS: TrueNAS revokes a key used over plain HTTP.
